title: Hungry for Ideas: Why Is Food Important?

bun.name: Bun
bun.persona: small, bouncy bread bun from the story, bright and brave

focusWords.kidDefinition: Things we eat to stay healthy and strong.
examples: Healthy food helps our bodies grow strong.
Bread is a food that many families eat every day.
focusWords.greekHint: τροφή: η τροφή μάς δίνει ενέργεια.

focusWords.kidDefinition: To have the same opinion as someone else.
examples: I agree with you, Maya. Bread is yummy!
Lingo and Maya agree that breakfast is important.
focusWords.greekHint: συμφωνώ: όλοι λένε το ίδιο, σαν ένα.

focusWords.kidDefinition: To have a different opinion from someone.
examples: I disagree. I think carrots taste sweet.
I disagree with your idea about pizza.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A list of foods you can order in a restaurant.
examples: The menu has pizza, soup and ice cream.
Maya reads the menu before she orders.
focusWords.greekHint: μενού: η λίστα με τα φαγητά στο εστιατόριο.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A cold, sweet food made from milk and sugar.
examples: I love chocolate and strawberry ice cream.
Maya eats ice cream on hot summer days.

focusWords.kidDefinition: Two slices of bread with food in the middle.
examples: Bun makes a cheese sandwich for his lunch.
A tomato sandwich is quick and easy to make.
focusWords.greekHint: σάντουιτς: ψωμί με γέμιση στη μέση.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A long orange vegetable that grows under the ground.
examples: Maya cuts a carrot for her salad.

focusWords.kidDefinition: Meat from a bird that many people cook for dinner.
examples: We have chicken and potatoes in the oven tonight.
Chicken is a good food for growing bodies.

focusWords.kidDefinition: A mix of fresh, cold vegetables, often with oil.
examples: Maya makes a big salad with tomatoes and cucumber.
We always eat a salad with every meal.

lines.text: Hello, friends! I am Lingo, your owl teacher.
Today we ask a big question: Why is food important?
Food gives us energy to run, jump and learn.
Meet Maya and her friend, the Little Bread Bun!

question.text: What is your favourite food, and why do you like it?

prompt.text: Which word means things we eat to stay healthy and strong?

explain.text: Food is anything we eat to stay healthy and strong.

prompt.text: Listen to Maya: I agree with you, Lingo! Which word did you hear?

explain.text: When you agree, you think the same as someone else.

prompt.text: Maya says cake is healthy. Lingo says, I ____. Cake is a sweet treat.

explain.text: Lingo has a different opinion, so he says disagree.

prompt.text: A menu is a list of toys you can buy in a shop.

explain.text: A menu is a list of foods in a restaurant, not toys in a shop.

prompt.text: Rabbits love this crunchy orange vegetable. Which word is it?

explain.text: A carrot is long, orange and crunchy.

prompt.text: Which word does not belong with the others?

explain.text: Soup, salad and pizza are foods, but a table is furniture.

prompt.text: Bun puts cheese between two slices of bread. It is a ____.

explain.text: Bread with food in the middle is a sandwich.

prompt.text: Listen to Lingo: Tonight we have roast chicken and potatoes. Which word did you hear?

explain.text: Chicken is meat from a bird that we cook for dinner.

prompt.text: It is hot. Maya wants something cold and sweet. She orders strawberry ____.

explain.text: Ice cream is a cold, sweet treat made from milk and sugar.

lines.text: Let's play Memory! Turn over two cards at a time.
Match each picture with its word. Say the word out loud!

prompt.text: Talk with your partner. Why is food important? Share your ideas.

frames: I think food is important because it gives me ___.
My favourite food is ___. I like it because ___.
I agree with you. I also like ___.

model.text: I think food is important because it gives us energy. My favourite food is salad. I agree with you, because salad is healthy.

lines.text: Brilliant work, friends! You met the Big Question today.
Food helps us grow, learn and play every day.
Next time, we will meet Bun and read his story!

exitTicket.text: Name one food you like and say why.
Which word means you have the same opinion as someone else?
